scenario: public crowded transit while walking, boarding and standing
product_purpose: provide a low-distraction wearable control with an explicit cancellation path
business_goals: explore a maintainable wearable product direction
maintenance_assumptions: replaceable wearable attachment is an unverified business assumption
cost_assumptions: target cost has not been supplied and must not be inferred

declared_requirements.title: explicit cancellation
declared_requirements.description: the wearer can terminate routine feedback without sustained visual attention
acceptance_criteria: a preregistered physical task protocol verifies an explicit cancellation path under the scoped transit conditions
